headline: 布克獎公布六本決選作品
context: 今年布克獎（Booker Prize）決選名單揭曉，前得主馬龍‧詹姆斯（Marlon James）與道格拉斯‧史都華（Douglas Stuart）再度入圍，角逐 5 萬英鎊獎金。決選名單上還有普立茲獎得主伊莉莎白‧斯特勞特（Elizabeth Strout）等六位作家，得獎結果將於 11 月 9 日星期一公布。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The two authors are in the running for the £50,000 award alongside a Pulitzer winner, a science fiction legend, a comic writer and a debut novelist • Booker judge Mary Beard on this year’s shortlist This year’s Booker prize shortlist features some very familiar names – previous winners Marlon James and Douglas Stuart are in the running once more, along with Pulitzer winner Elizabeth Strout and prominent British speculative fiction writer M John Harrison. Novelist and poet Luke Kennard and debut novelist Rebecca Perry are also in contention for the £50,000 prize, the winner of which will be announced on Monday 9 November. James, the Jamaican writer who took home the prize in 2015 for A Brief History of Seven Killings, was shortlisted this time for The Disappearers . Set in Aids-era Jamaica, the novel centres around an attack on a group of queer men rehearsing John Herbert’s prison-set play Fortune and Men’s Eyes. Coming in at 640 pages, it’s the longest on the list. Continue reading...
sources.title: Previous winners Marlon James and Douglas Stuart shortlisted for Booker prize

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: I found being a Booker judge hugely rewarding. All the works on our shortlist will change how you see the world • This year’s Booker prize shortlist As a Booker judge, I think I have worked harder than I have ever done before. Reading 163 novels in six months, making careful assessments, being ready to argue for your judgment, going back to check you haven’t got it wrong … in some ways it took more energy than actually writing a book. But it was also hugely rewarding and fun. I shall never forget the discussions in our regular judging meetings, and the pleasure of discovering how we had sometimes reached almost exactly the same view of a book, and sometimes dramatically diverged. There were no big newsworthy squabbles, but a lot of discussion, a lot of listening and re-reading. When each new batch of 30 or so novels arrived at home, through the spring, I plunged in and picked them out at random (only occasionally cheating by selecting a slim volume when I felt I needed to get my total up!) But so that you have more to go on, here is a quick guide to each of the books on the shortlist – in strictly alphabetical order. Explore the shortlist for this year’s Booker prize and, for a limited time, get all six books for only £79 at guardianbookshop.com . Delivery charges may apply. Continue reading...
sources.title: I read 163 novels and these are the six best: Mary Beard on judging the Booker prize

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: If James wins for “The Disappearers” or Stuart for “John of John,” it would be a rare second win for an author in the history of the prestigious literary award.
sources.title: Booker Prize 2026: Six Novels Make Shortlist

thread_text:
今年布克獎（Booker Prize）決選名單揭曉，前得主馬龍‧詹姆斯（Marlon James）與道格拉斯‧史都華（Douglas Stuart）雙雙再度入圍，角逐 5 萬英鎊獎金。詹姆斯這次入圍的作品《The Disappearers》，是六本決選作品中最厚的一本，長達 640 頁，故事背景設在愛滋病盛行時期的牙買加。決選名單上還有普立茲獎得主伊莉莎白‧斯特勞特（Elizabeth Strout）等作家，得獎結果將於 11 月 9 日星期一公布。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times，2026 年 9 月 23 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
